title: GTA 6 drew 7.91 million live viewers at launch 📺
subject: gta6
description:
Did you watch a stream or play it yourself? 👇

GTA 6's launch set new livestreaming records: Streams Charts measured a combined peak of 7.91 million viewers across Twitch, YouTube and Kick, and Twitch hit 3.31 million, its biggest peak ever for a game. GTA 6 is out now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Streams Charts (Nov 18, 2026), Inven Global (Nov 19, 2026), Variety (Nov 19, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: Almost 8 million people watched GTA 6 go live.
Streams Charts counted a combined peak of 7.91 million viewers on Twitch, YouTube and Kick within three hours of launch.
Twitch alone reached 3.31 million. No game has ever peaked higher there, not even League of Legends at the 2022 Worlds final.
In 24 hours, viewers watched about 125 million hours. IShowSpeed led all streamers with 4.47 million.
The internet felt it too. Exchange operator DE-CIX logged a record 33 terabits per second on November 18.
